canonical_ref.description: Optional merge-base / documentation ref; used as default --base-ref for compare-three when set

left_ref.description: Default left ref for compare / fetch

right_ref.description: Default right ref for compare / fetch

intent_pair.description: Optional intent pair string (same convention as --intent-pair on git compare)

intent_profile.description: Path to intent profile JSON, relative to repo root or absolute

hydrate_out_dir.description: Default output directory for merge-tonic hydrate

git_remote_url.description: Optional Git remote URL (https or git@) for tooling / documentation

hub_repo_id.description: Optional Hugging Face model repo id for weave blob prefetch/push

hub_default_dag.description: When true, prefer Hub as default weave CAS / index layer when online

replay_trace_source.description: Where weave replay resolves CTRD/steps when not passed explicitly

hub_index_path.description: Optional override path for Hub weave index JSON (default .tonic/hub/weave-index.v1.json on Hub)

compare_mode.description: Default compare mode: text snapshot merge vs weave merge when blobs exist
